title: Here and There among the Alps
short_title: Here and There among the Alps
summary: Frederica Plunket (died 1886), an Irishwoman who climbed in the Alps in the early 1870s, describes her own walks and ascents: the Tschingel Pass, the Titlis, Piz Languard, the Diavolezza, the Bernina and Stelvio passes, Monte Confinale, and peaks in the Tyrol and the Salzburg Alps. She writes of guides, inns, weather, and the people of the valleys, and encourages other women to climb above the snow line; a chapter of “Hints to Lady Pedestrians” gives practical advice.
